dossiers.catalyst_stack: Tesla opened paid Cybercab service in Austin on 2026-09-03 after Dutch RDW FSD Supervised type approval on 2026-04-10 and a Lithuania rollout on 2026-05-20, but NHTSA opened AQ26002 the same day and issued a 2026-09-10 Special Order on FMVSS certification while the EU FSD vote slipped toward December. Auto prints were split: Q1 2026 (2026-04-22) beat with $0.41 non-GAAP EPS and 21.1% gross margin, Q2 (2026-07-22) missed at $0.33 vs ~$0.53 with a 1.4% operating margin and -$1.09B FCF, and Q3 deliveries on 2026-10-02 were 486,532, about 25,000 above consensus but down 2.1% YoY. Industrial optionality added a 2026-09-24 Semi volume-production start in Nevada, a 2026-09-22 ZET SCALE 2,500-truck supplier award, a closed $1.95B AI-hardware deal, and Intel joining Terafab on 2026-04-07. Offsetting that, Tesla recalled 20,349 Model 3/Y units on 2026-08-04 for headlight brightness, went to trial on 2026-09-21 over Fremont racial-harassment claims, and saw JPMorgan cut its PT to $415 on 2026-10-09.
dossiers.key_assumption: Robotaxi/FSD optionality remains intact despite NHTSA Cybercab certification risk, and the Q2 margin/FCF collapse is transitory rather than a structural re-rating of the auto business.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 2026-04-16 Netflix reported Q1 revenue of $12.25 billion and a headline EPS beat that included a $2.8 billion WBD termination fee, and on 2026-04-22 the board authorized an additional $25 billion buyback. On 2026-07-16 Q2 revenue of $12.56 billion slightly missed consensus even as management narrowed full-year sales to $51.0-$51.4 billion. On 2026-09-18 Wells Fargo cut NFLX to Underweight with a $57 target on engagement, a move only partly offset when Deutsche Bank upgraded to Buy on 2026-09-29 and Evercore raised its target to $110. By 2026-09-30 Co-CEO Ted Sarandos said H1 engagement grew only about 2% and that Netflix is not growing as fast as he wants, while a 2026-09-15 UPC injunction, clustered August Form 4 sales, and early-October PT cuts from Goldman, Barclays, and Morgan Stanley kept the tape defensive.
dossiers.key_assumption: Management does not cut the $51.0-$51.4 billion 2026 revenue guide at the October 20 print, and engagement softness stays a multiple/PT issue rather than a subscriber or FCF break.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: On April 8, 2026 UEC received TCEQ approval and commenced production at Burke Hollow, the first new U.S. ISR uranium mine in more than a decade. Fiscal 2026 results on September 29 showed 229,294 pounds produced and Q4 output up 157% to 82,744 pounds, even as Q4 EPS of ($0.12) missed estimates, while September 28 final approvals for four Christensen Ranch header houses keep the ramp going. Post-print research split, with HC Wainwright ($26.75) and Roth ($17) reiterating Buys on September 30 versus National Bank’s October 5 cut to $15 and Zacks’ drop to Strong Sell. The May 28 government-affairs hire and Segra Capital’s October 6 550,000-share stake are secondary to whether the Texas and Wyoming wellfields convert permits into repeatable volume without another lumpy miss.
dossiers.key_assumption: Burke Hollow and the Christensen Ranch header houses continue ramping without permit slippage, and the Q4 EPS miss reflects lumpy inventory-sale accounting rather than weaker uranium demand or cost inflation.
